newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold closes lower on overseas selling.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold closes lower on overseas selling.

text.p: Gold closed lower on Wednesday after heavy selling interest from overseas in the afternoon session, dealers said.
Bullion extended its losses to close at US$337.50/338.00 an ounce, down US$1.00 from the local opening and US$2.30 from New York's US$339.80/340.30 close on Tuesday.
One bullion trader said long liquidation in morning trade and strong sales from overseas traders pushed down prices.
"Gold continued to fall in the afternoon session in response to the U.S. dollar surging higher," said a trader at a major bank.
"The market is still weak," a dealer said. "We don't see the bottom yet. The next target would be $332, then $330."
Local gold ended HK$13 lower at HK$3,126 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to +5.00 from its previous fix at zero.
